channel.description: Breaking news on the global luxury industry

item.title: EMBARGOED: Valcourt Group Q3 revenue down 4% organically, Asia weak
item.dc:creator: Luxury Wire staff
item.description: EMBARGOED UNTIL 23 OCT 2026 06:00 CET. Valcourt Group reported third-quarter revenue of 2.31 billion euros, down 4 percent on an organic basis, as weakness in mainland China and Hong Kong offset growth in Europe and the Middle East.

item.title: Venice floods as tide hits 120 cm, MOSE barriers not raised
item.dc:creator: Luxury Wire staff
item.description: High water flooded St Mark's Square in Venice on Tuesday morning after the tide reached around 120 centimetres, catching shopkeepers and tourists off guard.

item.title: Frieze London opens with cautious mood among collectors
item.dc:creator: Luxury Wire staff
item.description: Frieze London and Frieze Masters opened to VIPs in Regent's Park on Wednesday, with dealers describing a measured market in which buyers took longer to commit. Several mid-market galleries reported sales in the 50,000 to 250,000 pound range on the first day.

item.title: Idol effect: pink Ilvaro puffer sells out across Asia within days
item.dc:creator: Luxury Wire staff
item.description: A powder pink cropped down jacket worn by K-pop singer Yoon Ha-eun at Paris Fashion Week has sold out in stores and online across much of Asia, according to store staff and resale platforms.

item.title: Paris Fashion Week day three: street-style crowds swell outside the Tuileries
item.dc:creator: Luxury Wire staff
item.description: Crowds of fans outside the Tuileries gardens forced police to briefly close part of rue de Rivoli on Thursday as K-pop and Thai drama stars arrived for the afternoon shows.

item.title: Milan Fashion Week wraps with strong buyer turnout from Korea and the Gulf
item.dc:creator: Luxury Wire staff
item.description: Milan Fashion Week closed on Monday after six days of shows, with organisers reporting buyer registrations up 9 percent on last September, led by South Korea, Japan and the Gulf states. Attendance from mainland China rose but remains below pre-pandemic levels.

item.title: Moncler Genius unveils 'Polaris' capsule with oversized cape and balaclava
item.dc:creator: Luxury Wire staff
item.description: Moncler's Genius platform on Thursday released Polaris, a capsule built around extreme volume: a down cape priced at 2,900 euros, an oversized puffer at 2,400 euros and a knitted balaclava at 450 euros, in black, white and an icy light blue.
